description:
Brief info about Vinted 

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third.
The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people. 

Information about the position 

You’ll join Trust & Safety’s Actioning team, whose mission is to protect the Vinted community from harmful activities and content. The team owns critical mechanisms, including user reporting, moderation workflows, policy enforcement, and interventions against malicious users.

You will leverage your expertise in machine learning to research, design and implement new models for report and appeals prioritization, advanced sanctioning based on users' suspicions, and automation of moderation decisions. This involves working closely with our engineering teams to develop robust pipelines for data handling, feature engineering, model training, deployment, and continuous improvement. 

As a Senior Data Scientist, you will utilize advanced machine learning techniques to analyze text, images, and other data formats, tackling complex challenges to identify and address content that poses potential risks. You will champion best practices and methodologies, significantly enhancing the team's effectiveness and safeguarding Vinted. You will mentor others, influence the strategic direction for model development, and facilitate cross-functional collaborations to drive impactful results.

In this position, you’ll 

  • Lead the research, development, and end-to-end lifecycle of production machine learning models that prioritize and automate actions on harmful marketplace entities at scale.
  • Play a crucial role in establishing and refining essential machine learning processes, such as data versioning, creating labeling pipelines, and ensuring high-quality data availability for effective model training.
  • Actively collaborate across teams, particularly with Data Infrastructure and backend engineers, to develop and maintain scalable data pipelines and infrastructure, ensuring optimal performance and scalability of deployed models.
  • Influence and contribute to the strategic roadmap for the Actioning team, collaborating with Decision Scientists to test, assess, and continuously improve new models.

About you 

  • Proven track record in data science (4+ years of experience), with a strong foundation in machine learning, statistics, or computational mathematics.
  • Proficiency in both classical and deep learning techniques, and an adeptness in leveraging the latest tools and methodologies to solve complex problems.
  • Hands-on experience building and deploying agentic AI applications or LLM-powered workflows that handle large traffic, balancing quality, latency, and cost efficiency.
  • Deep understanding of the challenges involved in deploying, maintaining, and scaling real-time ML models in production, with a proven ability to address these challenges effectively.
  • Proven capability to work with engineering teams, designing and implementing efficient data ingestion, feature engineering, and model training pipelines that support robust and reliable model deployment.
  • Excellent problem-solving abilities, with a commitment to staying at the forefront of developments in machine learning and data science, driving innovation and thought leadership within the team.
  • Ability to clearly communicate complex ideas and technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders, ensuring that technical elements are properly understood and integrated to deliver business value.
  • Past experience with fraud detection, harmful content detection or any other adversarial domain would be considered an advantage. 

Work perks 

  • The opportunity to benefit from our share options programme
  • 25 days of paid annual leave
  • Newest MacBook models
  • Confidential Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for you and your family
  • Frequent team-building events
  • Home office support: we provide IT workstation equipment and a personal budget of up to €540 for home workplace furniture
  • Lunch benefit per working day
  • A personal monthly budget for shopping on Vinted
  • Collective Defined Contribution Pension plan
  • NS Business Card for your commute to the office by public transport
  • Company bike leasing scheme
  • Monthly budget for a flexible benefits platform
  • Work from Home allowance
  • A dog-friendly office

Working at Vinted 

Workation policy

Better balance holidays with workdays by working remotely! Up to 90 days per year in the EU, of these, 21 days can be spent globally. For non-EU citizens, it's 21 days worldwide. This can be combined with time off for vacation or personal time.

Individual learning budget

Each year, you’ll be given a learning budget (starting at €3,000), and a total of up to 10 working days over a 2-year period to support your personal and professional development.

Hybrid work

Our hybrid model, with 2 recommended office days a week, gives you and your team the flexibility to decide if and when you want to work from home, and when to catch up in person.

Equal opportunity

We welcome applications from everybody, regardless of your background, identity, or life experiences. Job openings come with guides, not checklists. If you’re excited about a role, but don’t identify with every point in the ‘About you’ section, apply anyway – you might still be the perfect match!

The annual gross salary range for this position excluding 8% holiday pay is:
€67.700—€91.500 EUR

Together, we’ve fulfilled and delivered over 20 million orders (and counting!), making us the largest direct to consumer flower business in Europe. Now home to a family of 3 beautiful brands, we’re driven by our vision to create the destination for making life a little more thoughtful and beautiful. And we won't stop at flowers and plants. Shape the roadmap: turn channel performance and data into clear, actionable insights that shape the wider paid media roadmap and forecasting, using Tableau and in-platform reporting. Stay ahead of the platform: stay up to date with best practices and market insights, particularly with Google, to prepare for upcoming changes, test new features and champion the latest innovations. Champion AI in search: maintain deep, practical knowledge of modern AI within search engine marketing – platform-level generative AI features, algorithmic updates and LLM-driven search behaviours – and share what you learn with the wider marketing team. Be the go-to expert: act as the go-to person for paid search across the marketing team – mentoring junior colleagues, sharing learnings (e.g. through Lunch & Learns) and giving constructive feedback on paid search work outside your direct remit. Protect share of voice: proactively monitor the competitor landscape, ensuring market share of voice, especially through peak trading moments. ✅ You’ll love this role if you… Are an expert in Google Paid Search: You have extensive, hands-on experience managing Google Search, Shopping, and Performance Max campaigns at scale (experience with Microsoft Advertising or App Campaigns is a bonus). Are fluent in tracking and analytics: You are comfortable working with analytics tools, conversion tracking, and Google Merchant Center, and feel confident navigating privacy- and consent-driven changes to measurement. Love data and reporting: You are a data-driven decision-maker who thrives on deriving insights. You are comfortable using both in-platform tools and Tableau to analyze performance across our custom-built, proprietary e-commerce stack (non-Shopify). Have agency management experience: You have a proven track record of managing third-party agencies to drive results and maintain strategic alignment. Are proactive and hands-on: You take full responsibility and initiative to get things done, with a willingness to roll up your sleeves and get stuck in. Are structured and organized: You take a thoughtful approach to planning, organization, and prioritizing your work to deliver on key business goals. Are curious and adaptable: You love figuring out new tech, testing, learning, and trying new things, often taking the initiative to optimize and improve existing processes. These are some of the skills and experience we think will enable success in this role, but please don’t worry if you are missing some of these. We value all backgrounds, perspectives, ideas and experiences, and encourage everyone to share their opinions openly within our caring and inclusive team. Our champions community actively advances our culture of inclusion and belonging, which is organised around 8 pillars of diversity. These cross-business networks offer additional opportunities for connection, education, support and celebration, and ensure that inclusivity continues to be embedded in our ways of working. 🧭 Our ways of working We really believe in the power of connection. For us that looks different depending on the team you work in. Some of our teams work together in person every day, whereas others may connect in person every quarter. We also believe in flexibility that supports you, the work you do, and your team. How much you work from home and from our office depends on a balance of those needs, and you’ll agree this with your manager. Whether it’s through a shared project, a learning and development opportunity, or an afterwork social - we trust our teams to make the right decisions (for them and us) about where and how they work each day. We’re big on collaboration, empathy, knowledge sharing and growth, and our values drive our priorities every day: Lead change for good: we have the guts to try new things and step up to do what matters most Think deeply, act swiftly: we make sure there’s thoughtful rationale behind our approach and always act swiftly to implement ideas Care wildly: we pour care and creativity into everything we do and pay attention to the things that make a difference Stay open, be curious: we’re open about what we’re doing and why, and we welcome challenges from each other 🌟 Work that works for you To care wildly for our customers, firstly we care wildly for our teams. We work hard to craft a culture of thoughtfulness and care, where there is a strong sense of inclusion and belonging, enabling all of our people to thrive and be successful each day. Our perks and benefits include: ⏰ Flexible working & work from abroad 🌴 25 days holiday + your birthday + flexible bank holidays, & option to buy additional holiday each year 💛 1 Volunteering day each year 🐣 Enhanced family leave and a workplace nursery scheme 🌱 A flexible training framework for every stage of your career 💐 Irresistible discounts on our products, blooms & subscriptions! 📈 Share in our success with a choice to take equity options from day 1 🏋 ClassPass membership: monthly credits to spend on fitness classes, yoga and much more! For more information on our perks & bens, please see www.bloomandwild.com/careers 🫱‍🫲 Getting hired We know that job searching can be daunting, and we want to do everything we can to ensure that your experience with us is a good one. Interviewing is a 2-way process, and we’re keen to answer all of the questions you have, so that you can be sure (and excited!) that we’re the right move for you. We believe in leading change for good, so if there’s anything that we can do to help you flourish throughout your application process with us, or if you have any feedback, please share this with us anonymously here so we can use this to improve your experience. #Bloom&Wild Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

description:
Senior Platform Engineer 

À propos du rôle et de l'équipe

La Cloud Platform Engineering (CPE) est une Business Unit de près de 200 personnes qui continue de se renforcer pour accompagner les ambitions tech de Decathlon. Notre objectif principal est de rationaliser le catalogue de produits techniques et de fournir des services clé en main pour les équipes IT, afin de leur permettre de se concentrer sur le développement de fonctionnalités à fort impact applicatif.

Au sein de la CPE, tu rejoindras l'équipe Cloud Dev. Notre mission est de fournir des fonctionnalités essentielles et abstraites pour le Cloud, en appliquant les meilleures pratiques de développement d'ingénierie logicielle pour unifier, sécuriser et optimiser nos plateformes.

Tu rejoindras une équipe à taille humaine, composée d'ingénieurs passionnés. Nous sommes fans de développement logiciel, d'Infrastructure as Code, de culture DevOps/SRE, d'automatisation, de veille technologique... et bien sûr, de sport !

Périmètre et missions d'un Platform Engineer

En tant que Platform Engineer, tu joueras un rôle central dans l'autonomisation des équipes de développement grâce à l'ingénierie de plateforme. Tes missions s'articuleront autour des piliers suivants :

1. Ingénierie Logicielle & Abstraction Cloud

  • Utiliser les meilleures pratiques de développement (Software Engineering, Software Architecture) pour concevoir du code propre, robuste et maintenable créant des couches d'abstraction au-dessus du Cloud.
  • Développer et industrialiser des API, outils internes et modules d'infrastructure en Python et Go.
  • Consommer et orchestrer des services Serverless (Google Cloud Functions, Google Workflows) et moderniser l'outillage de déploiement.

2. Infrastructure as Code & Automatisation DevSecOps

  • Concevoir, tester et déployer l'infrastructure de manière cohérente et automatisée avec Terraform.
  • Construire et optimiser des pipelines CI/CD modernes (de préférence avec GitHub Actions) intégrant les standards de sécurité DevSecOps dès la conception.
  • Automatiser les tâches récurrentes par du scripting (Python, Bash) afin de réduire l'effort manuel et maximiser la fiabilité.

3. Intégration Transversale & Excellence Opérationnelle

  • Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes Réseau, Sécurité et Bases de données pour garantir des intégrations fluides, performantes et sécurisées.
  • Rôle de Run Captain: prendre en charge le support de niveau 2/3, l'analyse des incidents et le traitement des demandes de service pour assurer la stabilité opérationnelle.
  • Contribuer à la définition et au respect des SLO/SLI ainsi qu'à la démarche de réduction du MTTR en automatisant la résolution des problèmes récurrents.

4. Accompagnement, Partage & Culture Produit

  • Rédiger une documentation technique propre et des guides utilisateurs pour faciliter l'adoption des services de plateforme.
  • Sensibiliser et former les équipes techniques aux bonnes pratiques d'utilisation des composants développés.
  • Participer à l'animation collective via la gestion agile de nos livrables dans JIRA et promouvoir le partage de connaissances au sein de l'équipe.

Ce dont tu auras besoin pour réussir

  • Expérience & Dév : Au moins 3 ans d'expérience en développement Python avec une solide maîtrise des pratiques modernes de génie logiciel.
  • Expertise Cloud : Fortes compétences et expérience avérée sur Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
  • Infrastructure as Code & CI/CD : Maîtrise de Terraform et très bonne pratique des pipelines CI/CD (idéalement GitHub Actions).
  • Scripting & Serverless : Bonne connaissance de l'automatisation (Python, Bash) et de l'architecture Serverless / événementielle.
  • Soft Skills & Esprit d'équipe : Excellent relationnel, fort sens de la satisfaction client/utilisateur interne, rigueur dans la documentation et aisance pour résoudre des problèmes complexes.
  • Langues : Anglais maîtrisé à l'oral comme à l'écrit, niveau B2 minimum.
  • Un plus apprécié : Connaissance pour le langage Go, l'utilisation de Google Workflows ou une certification GCP (Associate Cloud Engineer ou Professional Cloud Developer).

Ce que nous offrons

  • Esprit d'équipe & Sport : Une communauté sportive passionnée et du temps dédié à la pratique du sport.
  • Cadre de travail : Possibilité de travailler dans l'un des bureaux de Decathlon Digital à Paris ou Lille et 2 jours de télétravail par semaine.
  • Environnement de travail : Du matériel récent en accord avec tes missions et tes besoins techniques.
  • Opportunités & Mobilité : Une équipe locale au sein d'un réseau mondial, offrant des possibilités de carrière à l'international.
  • Développement professionnel : Accompagnement continu dans le développement de tes compétences (diversité des projets, certifications, formations internes et externes…).
  • Package de rémunération : Package attractif incluant la participation des employés aux actions de l'entreprise ainsi que des bonus mensuels, trimestriels et annuels.

DECATHLON DIGITAL 

Imaginez si la technologie nous permettait de repousser les frontières et d'offrir des expériences sportives inédites. C'est précisément notre ambition chez Decathlon Digital ! Nous sommes une équipe de plus de 5 000 experts en ingénierie logicielle, gestion de produits, données, cloud et cybersécurité, répartis à Paris, Lille et Amsterdam. Ensemble, nous créons la plus vaste plateforme sportive numérique, en exploitant les innovations technologiques pour optimiser la chaîne de valeur, concevoir des expériences connectées et donner une seconde vie à nos produits.

Changeons la donne pour de bon. Notre passion du sport nous guide et nous voulons qu’elle perdure. C’est pourquoi nous nous engageons à bâtir un modèle technologique plus durable, en réduisant notre impact direct sur l'environnement, et en créant un espace sûr et inclusif pour apprendre et nous épanouir ensemble. Rejoins l’équipe et façonnons le futur du sport.

We’re on a mission to become the go-to destination for students across Europe to find a trusted home away from home. We make every step of the rental journey simple and seamless, so students can focus on what really matters: studying, exploring, and growing.

With HousingAnywhere, Kamernet, and Studapart under our roof, we’re Europe’s largest student rental platform. You’ll find us in Rotterdam, Paris, and Cergy, always guided by our four core values: Ownership, We are enablers, We are changemakers, and We are connectors.

Your role

Help people find their next home with absolute certainty.

Moving to a new country is an adventure, but finding a home shouldn’t be the hardest part. At HousingAnywhere, we’re revolutionizing renting by building a platform that helps people confidently rent a home abroad.

Design isn't here to polish screens. It's here to shape the product. We are looking for a Senior Product Designer to own the Listing & Finding experience. You will define what discovering a home feels like: fast, relevant, trustworthy, and human.

As the design owner for one of the most important journeys in our marketplace, you will:

  • Shape the long-term vision for the search and discovery experience.
  • Lead projects from early discovery through launch and iteration.
  • Use qualitative research, behavioural data, and experimentation to make decisions, not opinions.
  • Define success, measure impact, and continuously improve your solutions.
  • Raise the quality bar across the design team through thoughtful critique and craft.
  • Contribute to our design principles, design system, and the way we build the product.

 

Your team

Collaborate deeply. Design with absolute purpose.

You'll work alongside Product, Engineering, Research, and Data as an equal partner to challenge assumptions, validate ideas, and turn ambiguity into a product that genuinely improves people's lives.

We move fast, we think ahead, and we focus on what our audience truly needs. You'll have the freedom to influence your team’s strategy in an environment that values:

  • Elegant interaction design and meaningful micro-interactions
  • Clear design principles and consistent systems
  • Accessible experiences
  • Quality over shortcuts

Shipping fast matters. Shipping something we're proud of matters even more. If you thrive on autonomy and solving complex puzzles, we want to hear from you.

 

Your profile

  • At least 7+ years of experience designing complex digital products.
  • Strong product thinking and problem framing skills.
  • Excellent interaction and visual design craft.
  • Experience in marketplaces, search or discovery products.
  • Experience running discovery and validating ideas.
  • Confidence working with data, metrics and experiments.
  • Experience collaborating closely with engineers and product managers.
  • A portfolio showing not only what you designed – but why.

 

What’s in it for you

  • Unlimited paid holidays, minimum-based not maximum!
  • Position based in our Rotterdam office with hybrid working policy (2 office days).
  • Flexibility to work remotely for up to 2 months per year!
  • 1,000 EUR personal development budget.
  • Complete coverage for commuting.
  • Personal equipment, including laptop and ergonomic setup.
  • Gym membership discount with GoVital or OneFit.
  • Dutch/English classes budget.
  • Variable pension scheme.
  • Diverse international community (46+ nationalities).
  • Pet-friendly office in Rotterdam city centre. 
  • Team-building events and after-work drinks every Friday.

description: At Kpler, we are dedicated to helping our clients navigate complex markets with ease. Kpler is expanding into high-value maritime verticals, with Cruise Liners and Port Operations representing two important opportunities. Both address a common market need: the lack of independent, reliable insights into actual performance, built on observed data rather than published schedules or self-reported information. In the cruise sector, operators and analysts often rely on published itineraries rather than actual vessel movements, despite the significant fuel and carbon costs associated with fleet operations. description: Jouw Missie bij CCS Geen dag is hetzelfde in deze rol. Samen met je collega’s zorg je ervoor dat wij succesvol onze softwareoplossingen bij klanten implementeren en dat onze klanten een excellente dienstverlening krijgen! Voor deze complexe systeemimplementaties en integratieprojecten zoeken we een zeer ervaren projectmanager. Je leert de verzekeringsbranche kennen en klanten helpen. Dat doe je niet alleen: je werkt samen met enthousiaste collega’s in een projectteam. Voordelen voor de sollicitant Als projectmanager krijg je veel verantwoordelijkheid, help je klanten en samen met je projectteam zet je mooie resultaten neer. Je kunt deels thuiswerken, deels op ons kantoor in Woerden en bij verschillende klanten in Nederland. Tijdelijk werken vanuit het buitenland kan ook dankzij onze workation-regeling (maximaal 30 dagen aaneengesloten per jaar). Bij ons draait het om klantgericht werken én werkplezier. Daarom is er volop ruimte voor ontspanning en plezier. Denk aan een levend tafelvoetbaltoernooi, pubquiz en een bier- & wijnproeverij. Ons actieve Fun-team zorgt elke maand weer voor iets leuks. En als je reislust nog niet is gestild met 25 vakantiedagen en een workation, dan kun je zelfs tot 20 extra verlofdagen bijkopen. Genoeg redenen om verder te lezen en te ontdekken of deze functie iets voor jou is, toch? Een voorbeeld van je werkdag Opstarten: Aan het begin van je werkdag heb je een dagstart met zowel collega’s als projectteamleden van de klant. Hierin bespreken jullie de voortgang, resultaten en eventuele hulpvragen. Na de dagstart: Allereerst neem je nog wat tijd met een van de consultants naar aanleiding van de dagstart. Je coacht en begeleidt de consultant en helpt deze met een hulpvraag. Vervolgens ga je aan de slag met het opstellen van de voortgangsrapportage. Hiermee zorg je voor proactieve en transparante rapportage over het project aan de klant. De stuurgroep met de klant is volgende week, vandaag spreek je samen met de delivery manager deze stuurgroep voor. Wat zijn de belangrijkste punten voor de klant en voor CCS en hoe vliegen we die aan. Na de lunch: Je checkt nog een paar tickets qua voortgang op het planboard, waarbij je de samenhang met de planning checkt. Vervolgens ga je naar de werksessie met het CCS projectmanagement guild. Hier werken jullie aan tickets om de CCS Prince2Agile projectmethodiek verder te verbeteren. Hierna heb je nog een afspraak met je collega van sales voor afstemming over een mogelijk vervolgproject bij de klant. Wie jij bent De ideale kandidaat beschikt over daadkracht, doorzettingsvermogen, enthousiasme en drive om projecten succesvol te leiden en verbeteringen door te voeren om te komen tot nog efficiëntere en klantgerichte projecten. Jij herkent jezelf in de volgende punten: · Je wordt blij van projectmanagement en blijft kalm bij verschuivende prioriteiten; · Je hebt bewezen ervaring met het succesvol uitvoeren van productsoftware-implementaties in een complexe, maar klantgerichte omgeving, binnen budget, planning en scope; · Je hebt ruime ervaring met diverse projectmanagement en delivery methodieken, bij voorkeur een Prince2-, Ipma of PMI of Agile / scrum certificaat; · Je vindt, net als wij, klanttevredenheid het uitgangspunt. Daarbij ben je in staat om de klantverwachtingen helder te analyseren, te managen en actief bij te sturen waar nodig; · Je beheerst de Nederlandse en Engelse taal uitstekend in woord en geschrift; · Jouw persoonlijkheid kenmerkt zich door: gestructureerd, motiverend, communicatief sterk, duidelijk, open, tikje eigenwijs, enthousiast, relativerend, creatief en pragmatisch; · Je haalt energie uit het opstellen en bewaken van planningen, analyseren van gegevens en opstellen van duidelijke, gestructureerde rapportages en presentaties; · Je hebt minimaal een afgeronde bachelor, bij voorkeur richting bedrijfskunde, bedrijfseconomie en/of informatica. Wat bieden wij jou? Naast de genoemde leuke functie binnen een groeiend en innovatief bedrijf bieden wij: · Salaris: We bieden je een salaris tussen € 5.590 en € 7.958 per maand (o.b.v. 40 uur per week), afhankelijk van je ervaring en kennis; · Middelen: Leaseauto, laptop, telefoon; · Werkdagen: Je bent minimaal 4 dagen per week beschikbaar, al heeft 5 dagen onze voorkeur; · Vergoeding voor thuiswerken: Je kunt gedeeltelijk thuiswerken en krijgt een onkostenvergoeding van € 2,40 per thuiswerkdag. Ook krijg je een budget van € 750,- om thuis een ergonomische werkplek in te richten; · Workation: Je kunt tot 30 dagen aaneengesloten per jaar vanuit het buitenland werken; · Leuke teamactiviteiten: Leer je collega’s beter kennen door deel te nemen aan maandelijkse evenementen georganiseerd door ons energieke Fun-team, zoals een pubquiz, Zomer BBQ, wine & beer tastings en movie night; · Vakantiedagen: Je krijgt 25 vakantiedagen en de mogelijkheid om maximaal 20 extra dagen bij te kopen; · Groei en ontwikkeling: De mogelijkheid om je vaardigheden en verantwoordelijkheden te ontwikkelen binnen de functie, middels opleidingen en Linkedin learning, of door te stromen naar een van de andere functies binnen CCS; · Vakantiegeld: Jaarlijks 8,33%; · Voordelen: Je krijgt een aantrekkelijke pensioenregeling met een lage eigen bijdrage en kunt gebruikmaken van collectieve verzekeringen met korting. Ook is er een bedrijfsfitnessregeling voor een gezonde levensstijl en een fietsregeling voor duurzaam vervoer. Waarom CCS? Omdat wij geloven dat werk meer is dan een baan. Het is een plek waar je jezelf kunt zijn, impact kunt maken en kunt groeien. Het is een omgeving waar je wordt geïnspireerd om het beste uit jezelf te halen en samen te werken aan een duurzame toekomst. Kom bij ons en ontdek wat er mogelijk is als je een carrière bouwt vol passie, plezier en betekenis. Jij bent de ontbrekende schakel in ons team. Word onderdeel van ons verhaal. 🚀 Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

description: Health can’t wait. Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR. Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond. ⭐️ The Senior Revenue Operations job Our Business Strategy & Operations team runs the most critical, strategic, and data-driven projects at Alan. It sits at the intersection of Sales, Product, and Finance, and covers four core areas: sales strategy and planning, sales effectiveness, sales enablement, and business segment leadership. You'll be joining the Sales Effectiveness team, whose mission is to make our sales organization run at its best across France, Belgium, Spain, and Canada. This team is a key lever on one of the company's most watched metrics: our customer acquisition cost. Why is this role interesting? High-impact scope: You'll work across the full sales organization, from Account Executives to BDRs, Account Management, and Customer Success Managers. Real ownership: You'll own initiatives end to end, from strategy and design to execution and adoption, not just delivery. Builder's playground: You'll have access to a modern stack, combining low-code tools, AI (Dust, Claude), Salesforce, and SQL, to ship things fast and at scale. Tangible results: Recent examples from our roadmap include fully automating slide deck generation for Sales (saving 1,000+ hours per year) and building an AI-powered outbound machine reaching a 15% discovery rate. What will you do with us? You'll own effectiveness initiatives end to end, setting the roadmap, designing the solution, building it, driving execution, and managing change across the organization. You'll spend meaningful time in the field to spot gaps in our sales process, then design smarter workflows by eliminating steps and increasing automation. You'll evaluate new tools and technologies, run tests, and roll out what works. You'll mostly work with low-code tools (like Zapier or n8n), AI, Salesforce, SQL via Metabase, and whatever else the job calls for. Enablement is a key part of the role: you'll shadow, train, measure adoption, and iterate until change sticks. ⭐ Is it you we're looking for? You'll be a great fit for the Revenue Operations team at Alan if you: Have at least 5 years of experience in RevOps / Sales Ops / Sales Effectiveness, several of them spent hands-on building the sales machine. Have proven experience with low-code tools and integrations (e.g. Clay, Make, Zapier, or equivalent) to build scalable workflows Have configured Salesforce yourself (objects, fields, flows) and can say what you personally built vs. what an integrator or another team did. Are able to build and maintain pipelines that produce actionable insights, with clear business impact Have excellent verbal and written communication skills; Have at least an advanced level in English. Are based in (or willing to relocate to) Paris, Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes, Biarritz, Madrid or Barcelona. For this role we are looking to hire within the C1-E level range. Everything else is a plus. We care about having a diversity of experiences, profiles and backgrounds in our team. 🙌 Perks & Benefits At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers. Therefore, we offer: Fair rewards. Generous equity packages complement your base salary, for permanent contracts only. Flexible office with hybrid setup. Amazing office space at our Paris HQ or sponsored co-working hubs in Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes, Biarritz, Madrid or Barcelona. All the tools you need. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Air, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and Bose noise-canceling headphones. Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours. Organize your time as you wish. Delightful healthcare insurance: Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% for you and your children, 90-100% for partners depending on your country (permanent contracts only). Transport. Generous transit benefit Learning & Training opportunities. A highly flexible training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises. Personal growth through coaching: At Alan, coaching isn't just a perk - it's core to who we are. Every Alaner is paired with a dedicated coach from day one, who helps maximize their impact, nurture engagement, and navigate Alan's values to develop their full potential. Learn more about our coaching culture. Parental leave. Extended parental leave for all new parents, for permanent contracts only. Important note: we hire people, not roles. description:
Join Axon and be a Force for Good.

At Axon, we’re on a mission to Protect Life. We’re explorers, pursuing society’s most critical safety and justice issues with our ecosystem of devices and cloud software. Like our products, we work better together. We connect with candor and care, seeking out diverse perspectives from our customers, communities and each other.

Life at Axon is fast-paced, challenging and meaningful. Here, you’ll take ownership and drive real change. Constantly grow as you work hard for a mission that matters at a company where you matter.

Your Impact

You will be the technical authority for RF hardware behind Dedrone's airspace security products — the RF detection sensors that find and classify drones, and the countermeasure systems that defeat them. You own the hard RF problems end to end: wideband receive chains, high-power transmit chains, and their physical realization on board. You do not carry direct reports, but you technically lead a group of RF hardware engineers and antenna designers — you set the standards they design to, review their work, and grow their capability. This is a hands-on role. You will spend real time in simulation, on the bench, and in the chamber.

What You'll Do

A key part of this role is helping teams succeed in that model by solving difficult operational problems, establishing standards and patterns, and building tooling and automation that makes systems easier to operate. You will also contribute directly to the software, tools, and systems that support Firefox engineering.

description: 31-38,75 uur per week | Utrecht | Hybride | € 600,– stagevergoeding | Wo-bachelor/-master | 6-12 maanden Jouw vooruitgang begint bij Berenschot De energietransitie is in volle gang. Overheden en bedrijven werken toe naar het behalen van Europese en landelijke doelstellingen, maar dit is vaak makkelijker gezegd dan gedaan. Om beleid tot uitvoering te brengen, moeten uiteenlopende belangen, overtuigingen en visies bijeenkomen. De grenzen tussen beleid en uitvoering zijn daarbij soms vaag. Op dat snijvlak werken wij: wat is de beste strategie om de doelen te behalen, en hoe werken we daar samen naartoe? Daar heb je kennis van de energietransitie voor nodig, maar ook gevoel voor mensen, context en organisaties. Dit is uitdagend, complex en leuk! Wil jij meewerken aan de meest urgente energie- en klimaatvraagstukken van Nederland? Wil jij met frisse ideeën en nieuwe inzichten bijdragen aan oplossingen voor uiteenlopende organisaties? En ben je benieuwd naar het werk bij een adviesbureau? Berenschot biedt jou de kans om tijdens een stage actief mee te werken aan deze complexe en actuele uitdagingen! De startdatum van je stage is 1 oktober 2026 (in overleg). Dit ga je doen Als stagiair(e) werk je onder andere mee aan opdrachten die gaan over energiesystemen, netcongestie, de warmtetransitie, betaalbaarheid en systeemweerbaarheid, op landelijk, regionaal én lokaal niveau. Opdrachtgevers zijn overheden (ministeries, provincies, gemeenten), netbeheerders, energiebedrijven, uitvoeringsorganisaties en woningbouwcorporaties. Daarbij werken we niet alleen voor, maar vooral ook mét onze opdrachtgevers. Een aantal voorbeelden van opdrachten waaraan wij werk(t)en: Het uitdenken en opbouwen van grote nationale uitvoeringsprogramma’s van het Klimaatakkoord, zoals het Nationaal Programma RES, het Nationaal Programma Lokale Warmtetransitie, het Nationaal Plan Energiesysteem, en programma’s rondom hernieuwbare opwek (zon op dak, wind op land, etc.). Het begeleiden van (grote) gemeenten bij het ontwikkelen van een warmte(net)strategie. Het ondersteunen van netbeheerders en provincies bij de ontwikkeling en programmering van het energiesysteem van de toekomst (Energievisies) en het verminderen van netcongestie. Overheden helpen met het opstellen van effectief klimaatbeleid met behulp van prognoses op basis van onze eigen Regionale CO2-routekaart. Het uitvoeren van volumeprojecties voor waterstofdragers richting 2035, om inzicht te krijgen in de verschillende stromen en knelpunten. Het ontwikkelen van een alternatief nettariefstelsel voor netbeheerders, waarmee de netbelasting wordt gespreid en netcongestie wordt beperkt. Overheden helpen met het opstellen en uitvoeren van beleid en plannen om de energietransitie rechtvaardiger te maken (bijvoorbeeld door bestrijding van energiearmoede, de inzet van fix-teams, het sturen op isolatie, etc.) Tijdens jouw stage krijg je de kans om mee te werken aan adviesopdrachten en lever je een bijdrage aan interne projecten, zoals bijvoorbeeld evenementen. Welke adviesopdrachten je doet, bepalen we samen met jou (afhankelijk van jouw interesses, achtergrond en kennis, en welke opdrachten er lopen). Quote “De variatie aan projecten, klanten en collega’s zorgt ervoor dat je snel een beeld krijgt van wat je doet als consultant. Je werkt als stagiair(e) écht mee aan maatschappelijk relevante projecten!” Hier kom je terecht Berenschot is een zelfstandig en onafhankelijk organisatieadviesbureau in Utrecht, waar we met meer dan 500 gedreven collega’s werken aan duurzame oplossingen voor de vraagstukken van onze opdrachtgevers. We dragen bij aan vooruitgang in organisaties en de maatschappij met onze adviezen en oplossingen. Onze organisatie heeft een platte structuur zonder partners, waardoor je invloed hebt op de projecten die je uitvoert. We streven altijd naar verrassende en vernieuwende oplossingen, wat ons uniek maakt. Met een open en informele cultuur, samenwerking tussen verschillende vakgebieden en veel vrijheid en verantwoordelijkheid vanaf dag één, krijg je de kans om te ontdekken wat je belangrijk vindt, waar je kracht ligt en waarin jij je wilt ontwikkelen. Dit zijn je directe collega’s Je gaat aan de slag binnen de adviesgroep Energie en leefomgeving in het Expertisecentrum Energie & Strategie (ECES). We zijn een club jonge, enthousiaste en ambitieuze professionals die sterk gemotiveerd zijn om bij te dragen aan de energietransitie. Je collega’s hebben bijvoorbeeld (technische) bestuurskunde gestudeerd, of bedrijfskunde, planologie, energy and environmental sciences, milieustudies, of politicologie. Dit neem je mee Berenschot is een verzameling van persoonlijkheden en achtergronden. We kijken dus vooral of je goed in het team past. We zoeken in elk geval een flinke dosis energie en enthousiasme, gecombineerd met nieuwsgierigheid en de ambitie om jezelf op inhoud en adviesvaardigheden te ontwikkelen. Je werkt graag zelfstandig, maar net zo goed samen. Verder heb je: een sterk analytisch vermogen en uitstekende sociale vaardigheden sterke communicatieve vaardigheden en kun je helder en gestructureerd rapporteren duidelijke interesse in en affiniteit met de energietransitie en verduurzamingsvraagstukken de intrinsieke drive om maatschappelijke impact te maken. Dit bieden we jou Bij Berenschot bieden we een unieke werkomgeving zonder aandeelhouders of partners, wat ons de vrijheid geeft om te ondernemen en ons in te zetten voor maatschappelijke thema’s. We hebben een informele cultuur, korte communicatielijnen en creëren volop kansen voor persoonlijke en professionele groei. Daarnaast bieden we: een marktconforme stagevergoeding van € 600,– per maand (op fulltimebasis) een laptop flexibele (thuis)werkmogelijkheden persoonlijke begeleiding door een ervaren adviseur een stimulerende en leerzame werkomgeving waarin ruimte is voor eigen inbreng de mogelijkheid om een netwerk op te bouwen binnen Berenschot en onze relaties de mogelijkheid om in te stromen in een Berenschot-traineeship. Om stage te kunnen lopen bij Berenschot, moet je gedurende de gehele stageperiode ingeschreven staan bij een universitaire onderwijsinstelling. Afstuderen bij ons is een optie, de mogelijkheden van een scriptie bespreken we graag samen verder met je. Solliciteer meteen Wil jij ook een trotse Berenschotter worden? Solliciteer direct! Collega Rob Lindner beantwoordt al jouw vragen met plezier. Neem contact op met Rob via . Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

description:
About Ping Identity: 

At Ping Identity, we believe in making digital experiences both secure and seamless for all users, without compromise. We call this digital freedom. And it's not just something we provide our customers. It's something that inspires our company. People don't come here to join a culture that's built on digital freedom. They come to cultivate it. 

Our intelligent, cloud identity platform lets people shop, work, bank, and interact wherever and however they want. Without friction. Without fear. 

While protecting digital identities is at the core of our technology, protecting individual identities is at the core of our culture. We champion every identity. One of our core values, Respect Individuality, reminds us to celebrate differences so you are empowered to bring your authentic self to work.

The ideal candidate will have a good understanding of financial portfolio data, a foundational level of python programming skills, exceptional communication skills and the ability to deliver results in alignment with project deadlines while meeting high quality standards.

Applicants must have, and maintain, the right to work in the United Kingdom from the first day of employment. Please note that visa sponsorship is not available for this role.

Our Values 

  • Act Like an Owner - Think and operate with intention, purpose and care. Own outcomes.

description: Bij DeWarmte maken we slimme en betaalbare warmtepompen waarmee we woningen van het gas af helpen. We ontwerpen onze producten zelf, assembleren ze in Utrecht en zorgen samen met onze installatiepartners dat ze bij steeds meer mensen thuis komen te staan. Steeds meer woningen worden verwarmd met onze warmtepompen. En dat betekent dat we ook steeds meer installaties moeten monitoren, klanten ondersteunen en technische problemen oplossen. Daarom zoeken we een Technical Support Engineer die ons support team komt versterken. Je helpt klanten en monteurs bij technische vragen, onderzoekt storingen en zorgt dat onze warmtepompen optimaal blijven functioneren. Tegelijkertijd kijk je verder dan het probleem van vandaag. Waarom ontstaat een storing? Hoe kunnen we die in de toekomst voorkomen? En hoe kunnen we onze support slimmer organiseren? Je lost dus niet alleen problemen op, maar helpt ons ook om onze producten en service steeds beter te maken. Wat ga je doen? Als Technical Support Engineer ben je een belangrijk aanspreekpunt voor technische vragen over onze warmtepompen. Je combineert technisch inzicht met klantcontact en werkt nauw samen met onze service-, product- en engineeringteams. Je helpt klanten en monteurs bij technische problemen Je analyseert storingen en zoekt uit wat er aan de hand is, bijvoorbeeld door systeemdata en instellingen te onderzoeken. Je ondersteunt klanten telefonisch en per mail bij technische vragen en problemen. Je helpt installateurs en servicemonteurs bij het oplossen van technische problemen. Je past waar nodig instellingen van warmtepompen aan om hun prestaties te optimaliseren. Je schakelt servicemonteurs in wanneer een probleem niet op afstand kan worden opgelost en zorgt voor een goede overdracht. Je helpt onze support steeds slimmer en beter te maken Je herkent terugkerende problemen en denkt mee over structurele oplossingen. Je maakt en verbetert technische documentatie, handleidingen en werkinstructies. Je deelt inzichten uit de praktijk met onze product- en engineeringteams, zodat we onze warmtepompen verder kunnen verbeteren. Je denkt mee over hoe we onze processen en systemen kunnen verbeteren en automatiseren. Je komt terecht in een groeiend team waarin nog niet alles vastligt. Dat betekent dat je veel kunt leren, verantwoordelijkheid krijgt en zelf invloed hebt op hoe we werken. Wat breng je mee? We zoeken iemand die technisch nieuwsgierig is, graag problemen oplost en energie krijgt van het helpen van anderen. Je hoeft nog geen expert in warmtepompen te zijn. We leren je graag hoe onze systemen werken. Wat we belangrijk vinden: Je hebt een technische hbo-opleiding afgerond, bijvoorbeeld in werktuigbouwkunde, elektrotechniek of een vergelijkbare richting. Je hebt technisch en analytisch inzicht en vindt het leuk om uit te zoeken hoe systemen werken. Je communiceert duidelijk en prettig, ook met mensen die minder technische kennis hebben. Je spreekt en schrijft goed Nederlands. Je bent zelfstandig, leergierig en neemt initiatief wanneer je ziet dat iets beter kan. Je vindt het leuk om zowel met techniek als met mensen bezig te zijn. Je bent minimaal 4 dagen per week beschikbaar. Mooi meegenomen, maar zeker geen vereiste: Ervaring met technische support, troubleshooting of klantcontact. Kennis van warmtepompen, installatietechniek of andere technische systemen. Ervaring met Python, data-analyse of het automatiseren van processen. Wat bieden wij jou? Een salaris van €3.000 tot €4.000 bruto per maand op basis van een fulltime dienstverband, afhankelijk van je ervaring. 27 vakantiedagen. Een pensioenregeling en reiskostenvergoeding. De mogelijkheid om mee te delen in het succes van DeWarmte via onze Stock Appreciation Rights (SAR). Veel ruimte om te leren, jezelf te ontwikkelen en verantwoordelijkheid te nemen. Een informele werkomgeving met korte lijnen en collega's die graag samenwerken. De mogelijkheid om deels vanuit huis te werken, naast onze gezamenlijke kantoordagen. En natuurlijk de kans om bij te dragen aan de energietransitie met producten die we zelf ontwikkelen en verbeteren. Zin om mee te bouwen? Bij DeWarmte houden we van mensen die initiatief nemen, nieuwsgierig zijn en samen dingen beter willen maken. Je hoeft niet alles al te kunnen. Als je graag leert, verantwoordelijkheid neemt en energie krijgt van techniek en het helpen van mensen, maken we graag kennis met je. Capture and translate expert and unstructured knowledge into ontologies, knowledge graphs, and semantic models, ensuring accuracy and context for automation and insights. Apply advanced analytics on knowledge graphs to drive problem-solving and actionable insights. Must have skills : Databricks Unified Data Analytics Platform Good to have skills : Data Engineering, Graph Databases, Neo4j Minimum 7.5 year(s) of experience is required Educational Qualification : 15 years full time education Role Summary / Description AI Powered Tech Talent Senior Engineer role in Knowledge Engineering focused on designing, building, and leading significant workstreams for enterprise-scale Knowledge Graph, semantic layer, ontology, and AI knowledge solutions using Databricks lakehouse and AI capabilities. The role leads a substantial knowledge engineering scope within a large program, translates real-world business problems into scalable AI and KG solutions, guides technical direction, and contributes to thought leadership, reusable assets, and delivery standards. The role must bring relevant industry experience across domains such as BFSI, healthcare, retail, telecom, manufacturing, energy, public sector, or life sciences, applying semantic AI, knowledge graphs, LLM grounding, governed data products, lakehouse pipelines, and Databricks engineering patterns to deliver measurable client value. Key Responsibilities Engineer Databricks-based knowledge engineering solutions using Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Databricks SQL, Workflows, MLflow, Feature Engineering, Vector Search, Model Serving, notebooks, jobs, APIs, and cloud storage integrations. Build lakehouse graph ingestion pipelines, semantic data products, vector integrations, LLM grounding layers, APIs, and governed access patterns on Databricks while improving performance, reliability, scalability, and cost efficiency. Lead the build of Knowledge Graph solutions that transform client data architecture within a large program scope. Direct the design, development, and implementation of AI, semantic layer, ontology, taxonomy, schema, graph modeling, and knowledge curation solutions, ensuring all components work together seamlessly. Work with project leaders, delivery leads, client stakeholders, architects, data engineers, AI engineers, product teams, and domain SMEs to create standout graph-powered data and AI offerings. Develop strong client relationships, earn trust as a key advisor, and explain the business value of semantic layer, ontology, and knowledge graph solutions. Make the business case for the recommended semantic layer solution and contribute meaningfully to sales, pre-sales, estimation, proposal inputs, and solution shaping activities. Provide thought leadership on technology trends, innovation opportunities, limitations, risks, delivery concerns, and practical adoption of knowledge graphs, semantic AI, LLM grounding, RAG, and agentic systems. Design, evaluate, and maintain ontologies, schemas, standards, and reusable engineering patterns, while guiding teams on data model quality and implementation methods. Lead a team or workstream within a larger program, mentor engineers, review design/code/configuration, and guide adoption of new methodologies, model building techniques, and algorithms. Collaborate across business and technical teams to drive end-to-end delivery for the assigned scope and demonstrate value to business and technology stakeholders. Required Qualifications Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Mathematics, Data Science, or a related field. Minimum 3 years of experience with Knowledge Graph technologies such as RDF, SPARQL, LPG, SHACL, OWL, graph query languages, schema design, ontology management, and KG curation. Minimum 3 years of experience in schema design, ontology management, semantic modeling, taxonomy management, metadata management, and knowledge graph curation. Minimum 3 years of experience designing and developing Knowledge Graph solutions and graph-based ML models across functional and technical workstreams. Minimum 2 years of experience implementing end-to-end data pipelines for AI applications, especially LLM-enabled or enterprise knowledge applications, with hands-on design and configuration. Minimum 4 years of experience with relational databases, object stores, graph databases such as Stardog, Neo4j, Amazon Neptune or equivalent, and vector databases. Minimum 2 years of experience leading a team or workstream within a larger program. Experience collaborating with engineering, research, product, domain, client-facing, and cross-functional teams across multiple time zones. Required Skills/ Experience Hands-on experience building Databricks-based knowledge engineering solutions with Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Databricks SQL, Workflows, MLflow, Feature Engineering, Vector Search, Model Serving, notebooks, jobs, APIs, and cloud storage integrations. Strong Python, SQL, and Spark/PySpark experience with frameworks and tools such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, SPARQL, SHACL, Apache Airflow, Apache NiFi, and ETL/ELT pipeline tooling. Practical knowledge of NLP and search techniques including entity extraction, entity resolution, semantic search, prompt engineering, LLM grounding, and enterprise-scale LLM applications. Ability to design and implement scalable lakehouse graph ingestion, ontology/schema pipelines, semantic layers, vector search/retrieval patterns, RAG pipelines, and governed knowledge services. Strong collaboration, technical leadership, delivery ownership, documentation, and stakeholder communication skills. Good to Have Skills 2+ years of hands-on experience with cloud/data platforms, with Databricks specialization and exposure to AWS, Azure, or GCP in multi-cloud environments. Databricks certifications such as Data Engineer Professional, Machine Learning Professional, or related lakehouse credentials. Industry experience in BFSI, healthcare, retail, telecom, manufacturing, energy, public sector, or life sciences, including domain ontologies, data models, compliance needs, and knowledge-driven use cases. External client-facing consulting experience, proposal support, solution shaping, or pre-sales exposure. Advanced degree or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Mathematics, Electrical Engineering, Data Science, or a related discipline broad exposure to diverse ML techniques and agentic systems. 15 years full time education About Accenture Accenture is a leading global professional services company that helps the world’s leading businesses, governments and other organizations build their digital core, optimize their operations, accelerate revenue growth and enhance citizen services—creating tangible value at speed and scale. You Are: We are looking for a Back-End Engineer to design, build, and operate the data infrastructure and services that power our AI-driven knowledge platform. description: About the Centre for Advanced Data APAC The Centre for Advanced Data (C4AD) is Accenture's specialist centre of excellence that sets the architecture standard for modern, AI-ready data estates across APAC, and mobilises the talent to deliver them at scale. The C4AD operates across three core disciplines: Master Data Architecture, Knowledge Engineering, and Data Products. Every practitioner in the C4AD is expected to apply agentic and generative techniques as the default way of working, not as an add-on. The centre supports large-scale data and AI transformation programmes across the region, ranging from enterprise data modernisation to AI-ready platform builds. Job Description Join the Centre for Advanced Data APAC as a Knowledge Engineer, where you will own ontology and semantic strategy across engagements, set the knowledge-engineering standards for the practice, and assure the semantic layers that ground enterprise AI. You will define how the C4AD approaches knowledge representation across programmes, and hold the line on quality, consistency, and semantic integrity as those programmes scale. You will work closely with Data Architects and AI Engineers, ensuring that the ontologies and knowledge graphs you define and govern give AI systems something real, structured, and reliable to reason over. Project Description / Key Responsibilities Own ontology and semantic strategy across C4AD engagements, setting the approach, standards, and quality bar for knowledge engineering across the practice. Assure semantic layers that ground enterprise AI, reviewing, governing, and signing off on the ontological structures that AI systems in our programmes reason over. Design, develop, and govern enterprise ontologies, taxonomies, and knowledge graphs that accurately represent business domains, their relationships, and the rules that govern them. Build and govern semantic models using RDF/OWL, SHACL, and SPARQL, and property graph approaches using platforms such as Neo4j, Amazon Neptune, or Stardog. Apply and adapt industry-standard ontologies (e.g. FIBO, BIAN, GS1, TM Forum) to meet organisation-specific semantic requirements. Develop and enforce semantic modelling standards, naming conventions, versioning, and curation workflows, and drive adoption of those standards across delivery teams. Enable AI and ML applications through knowledge graph enrichment, entity resolution, semantic search, and ontology-powered RAG pipelines. Engage business SMEs and domain experts to elicit and formalise implicit business rules, relationships, and concepts into explicit ontological structures. Key Skills 5+ years of experience in knowledge engineering, ontology design, or semantic modelling, with a track record of owning the knowledge engineering approach on complex programmes, not just contributing to it. Proven deep expertise in ontology engineering, authoring OWL ontologies, RDFS schemas, SHACL constraint shapes, and SPARQL queries, with real enterprise delivery behind it. Hands-on experience with graph databases and knowledge graph platforms such as Neo4j, Amazon Neptune, Stardog, or GraphDB. Proficiency with semantic tooling including Protégé, TopBraid Composer, or equivalent ontology authoring environments. Strong understanding of how semantic models connect to downstream data products, metadata catalogues, and AI/ML enrichment workflows, and the ability to assure that integration is sound. title: Knowledge Engineer

description: VOUS ÊTES Vous êtes un solide contributeur individuel en ingénierie des connaissances évoluant vers un rôle de chef d'équipe. Vous maîtrisez l'ensemble du cycle de vie du développement des graphes de connaissances. Vous transformez des problèmes du monde réel en solutions pratiques, efficaces et évolutives basées sur l'IA et les graphes de connaissances, en travaillant de manière opérationnelle sur l'ensemble du cycle de vie, de l'ingestion à la modélisation, la curation et le déploiement. Vous appliquez les méthodologies, techniques et algorithmes actuels avec l'architecture appropriée et commencez à guider les ingénieurs juniors sur le projet. Vous restez à jour sur l'ingénierie des connaissances, l'IA générative, les LLM et les modèles multimodaux ; vous recherchez les opportunités de les appliquer au problème traité. Vous concevez, évaluez et maintenez les ontologies lorsque cela est nécessaire. Vous contribuez à démontrer la valeur des approches basées sur l'IA générative et les graphes de connaissances pour un problème métier donné. Vous partagez vos apprentissages avec l'équipe. Vous collaborez avec les utilisateurs, les représentants des cas d'usage, les ingénieurs, les architectes et les concepteurs UI afin de fournir votre contribution à une solution de bout en bout. LE TRAVAIL Construire des composants de graphe de connaissances qui contribuent à la transformation de l'architecture de données d'un client. Concevoir, développer et mettre en œuvre des solutions d'IA et des solutions sémantiques ; veiller à ce que votre travail s'intègre proprement au système global. Travailler aux côtés de l'équipe projet et des responsables de delivery. Établir de solides relations de travail avec les interlocuteurs clients de votre domaine d'activité. Aider à rassembler les éléments justificatifs soutenant la solution de couche sémantique recommandée. Soutenir les efforts commerciaux d'Accenture lorsque cela est demandé. Continuer à développer vos compétences dans les solutions Data & AI de pointe, en particulier les technologies agentiques, et partager ces connaissances avec l'équipe. QUALIFICATIONS DE BASE (REQUIS) Diplôme de licence ou équivalent, ainsi qu'au moins 3 des éléments suivants : Expérience avec les technologies de Knowledge Graph (RDF, SPARQL, LPG, SHACL) Expérience démontrée en conception de schémas, gestion d'ontologies et curation de Knowledge Graphs Familiarité avec la conception et le développement de solutions de Knowledge Graph et de modèles de machine learning basés sur les graphes (fonctionnel + technique) Expérience dans la mise en œuvre de pipelines de données de bout en bout pour les applications d'IA (en particulier les LLM), avec une expérience pratique de la conception et de la configuration Solides connaissances et expérience des bases de données relationnelles, des stockages objets, des bases de données graphe (Stardog, Neo4J, Amazon Neptune) et des bases de données vectorielles (aucune exigence en matière de leadership ou de développement commercial à ce niveau) QUALIFICATIONS PRÉFÉRÉES Expérience pratique avec les plateformes cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP) Expérience professionnelle avec Python, ainsi qu'avec des frameworks tels que TensorFlow, PyTorch et des outils de création de pipelines ETL (par exemple Apache NiFi, Airflow) Expérience pratique des techniques de NLP et/ou de recherche Prompt engineering et LLMs pour des applications à l'échelle de l'entreprise Vous avez une expérience de chef d'équipe Solides compétences en collaboration avec la capacité de travailler au sein d'équipes d'ingénierie, de recherche et de produit réparties sur plusieurs fuseaux horaires Vous avez une expérience de conseil en contact direct avec des clients externes Expérience étendue de diverses techniques de machine learning et des systèmes agentiques. description: UKI Finance RP Finance Data Engineer The practice Finance is one of the most demanding and valuable environments in which to apply modern technology. You will work with complex enterprise data, mission-critical processes and high-impact decisions, using AI, data and engineering to reshape how organisations plan, control performance and allocate resources. The opportunity goes beyond building technically strong solutions: you will see how those solutions influence cash, profitability, risk and business growth, and take them from experimentation into trusted, production-ready capabilities. Working in Finance Reinvention allows you to remain close to leading-edge technology while developing an understanding of the CFO agenda, gaining exposure to senior decision-makers and building the commercial judgement needed to solve enterprise-wide challenges. This combination of deep technical capability, finance-domain expertise and measurable business impact creates a differentiated career path that is difficult to develop in a purely technology-focused role. Purpose of the role Responsible for the finance data and ontology layer on which agentic solutions depend. Builds the entities, relationships, definitions, lineage and data contracts sourced from live ERP and EPM systems to a standard that supports controlled and auditable agent behaviour. The role owns governed finance data products, semantic models and retrieval-ready data services that are secure, permission-aware, observable and suitable for AI, analytics and decision intelligence. Responsibilities Build and extend the finance ontology covering supplier, invoice, customer, receivable, journal, account, cost centre and forecast line, and the relationships between them, including controlled vocabularies, business glossaries, hierarchy history, ownership and lifecycle versioning. Engineer pipelines from SAP, Oracle, Workday and EPM platforms into governed data products, supporting structured and unstructured sources, batch and incremental ingestion, APIs, files and change-data-capture patterns as appropriate. Build entity-resolution and master or reference-data capabilities that reconcile identifiers, definitions and hierarchies across source systems and preserve source-to-target mappings. Establish lineage and evidence sufficient for audit, so that agent output can be traced to source, with automated data-quality checks, finance reconciliations, completeness and freshness measures, observability, alerts and recoverable operations. Define data contracts between delivery pods, and between Accenture delivery and client platform teams, including schemas, quality thresholds, access rules, service levels, versioning and change-control expectations. Experience deploying software or data products on Azure, AWS or GCP, DataBricks, Snowflake, Palantir etc using relevant cloud services and at least one of containers, Kubernetes or serverless patterns. Work with AI Engineers on retrieval and grounding, ensuring models receive appropriately scoped context, including chunking and embedding strategies, hybrid or graph retrieval, permission-aware filtering, provenance and retrieval evaluation. Implement security and privacy controls across the data lifecycle, including role- or attribute-based access, row or document-level permissions, masking or tokenisation, retention, tenant isolation and audit logging. Apply software and DataOps practices including Git, automated testing, CI/CD, infrastructure as code where relevant, performance tuning, cost optimisation and production support. Collaborate with finance SMEs, data owners, architects and governance teams to agree definitions, resolve data issues and embed sustainable stewardship and operating ownership. Data engineering Essential experience Production data engineering, including SQL, Python, a modern data platform such as Databricks, Snowflake or Fabric, and orchestration tooling, with practical experience of ETL/ELT, data testing, Git and CI/CD; PySpark or dbt experience is beneficial. Working knowledge of finance data structures, including chart of accounts, entity hierarchy, sub-ledger to ledger relationships, intercompany and period close, together with actual, budget and forecast data, currencies, consolidation and management hierarchies. Strong data modelling discipline and the ability to justify and maintain definitional standards, including canonical or semantic models, data contracts, schema evolution, metadata, lineage and data-quality controls. Experience extracting and reconciling data from enterprise applications or complex operational systems using APIs, files, database interfaces or change-data-capture patterns. Experience deploying software or data products on Azure, AWS or GCP, DataBricks, Snowflake, Palantir etc. using relevant cloud services and at least one of containers, Kubernetes or serverless patterns. (AI engineer – desirable) Understanding of secure data engineering, including access control, encryption, secrets, privacy, retention and the handling of sensitive or regulated data. Ability to work with finance SMEs and technical teams to translate business definitions and controls into implementable data products and acceptance criteria. At least 10 years’ relevant professional experience Knowledge graph, semantic layer or ontology engineering experience, including technologies or standards such as Neo4j, RDF/OWL, SKOS, SPARQL or GraphRAG. Data quality, master data management or lineage tooling experience, including entity resolution, business glossaries, catalogues or platforms such as Collibra, Purview or Unity Catalog. Exposure to SOX or external audit requirements, GDPR, model-risk controls or regulated-data environments. Detailed knowledge of one or more finance-platform data models, such as SAP S/4HANA, Oracle Fusion, Workday Financials, Anaplan, OneStream or SAP Analytics Cloud. Experience evaluating retrieval quality for AI workloads, including embeddings, vector stores, hybrid search or reranking. description: Application deadline: Oct 27, 2026 The Amazon Web Services Professional Services (ProServe) team is seeking a Delivery Consultant specializing in Data to join our Healthcare and Life Sciences (HCLS) practice. You will be at the center of the most consequential shift in enterprise technology: making organizations truly AI-ready. Every agentic AI system, every foundation model grounded in enterprise knowledge, and every GenAI application that moves from prototype to production depends on the data layer beneath it - and that's what you build. You will design and implement modern data platforms (lake, lakehouse, mesh), architect data pipelines that transform raw, fragmented data estates into governed, AI-ready assets; and design and implement enterprise RAG architectures, vector stores, semantic ontologies, and knowledge graph architectures that allow foundation models and AI agents to reason accurately, access data securely, and execute autonomously within regulated environments. You will work hands-on inside HCLS customer environments with complex data lineage, regulatory overlays (GxP, HIPAA, CDISC), and legacy systems, and ship production-grade data products that serve multiple downstream consumers, from ML model training to agentic orchestration layers. The AWS Professional Services organization is a global team of experts that help customers realize their desired business outcomes when using AWS services. We work together with customer teams and the AWS Partner Network (APN) to execute enterprise cloud computing and AI transformation initiatives. This role requires approximately 50% co-location on site with customer, AWS and partner teams within the U.S. 10044 221100 Key job responsibilities - Design and implement production-grade data pipelines, data lakes, lakehouses, and data mesh architectures within enterprise HCLS environments, integrating with legacy systems and existing data governance frameworks - Build data products that serve multiple downstream applications and use cases — from AI/ML model training to agentic AI systems, ensuring data quality, lineage, and reliability at scale - Operate with a high degree of autonomy within fast-moving delivery engagements, making judgment calls on data modeling, pipeline design, and architecture without waiting for perfect specifications or constant oversight - Navigate complex data access, security, and privacy requirements unique to pharma and healthcare including GxP compliance constraints, HIPAA, and regulatory data governance frameworks - Architect contextual knowledge layers, including ontologies and knowledge graphs leveraging AWS Context, Amazon Bedrock Knowledge Bases, and custom ontology extensions to equip AI agents with the vocabulary and guardrails to reason accurately and execute autonomously within regulated environments - Collaborate across organizational boundaries to secure data access, understand source system context, and resolve data quality challenges with teams across customer IT, business, and partner organizations - Deliver iteratively when requirements are ambiguous, translating incomplete business needs into well-architected data solutions that can evolve as customer understanding matures - Apply AI-DLC (AI-accelerated Development Life Cycle) methodologies to data delivery to redesign data workflows to become AI-native for accelerated scale and pace About the team ABOUT AWS: Diverse Experiences Amazon values diverse experiences. Bachelor's degree, or 7+ years of professional or military experience - 5+ years of experience in data engineering, data architecture, and/or data platform development, with hands-on implementation of production data pipelines - Experience with modern data platform design patterns, including data lakes, lakehouses, data mesh, and zero-ETL patterns and streaming architectures, using services such as Amazon SageMaker Lakehouse, SageMaker Unified Studio, Amazon S3 Tables, Amazon Redshift, and zero-ETL integrations - Experience with architecting and engineering ontologies and knowledge graphs in enterprise environments - AWS certifications in Data Analytics or Machine Learning Specialty preferred - Experience in the healthcare and life sciences industry, including familiarity with compliance and security frameworks (HIPAA, GxP) and clinical data standards (OMOP, CDISC, FHIR) - description: You enjoy shaping the future of product innovation as a core leader, driving value for customers, guiding successful launches, and exceeding expectations. Join our dynamic team and make a meaningful impact by delivering high-quality products that resonate with clients. As a Product Manager in C360 - World Model, you will be the hands-on owner of the World Model as a product — accountable for its structure, coherence, quality, and direction — delivering not by running a large team, but by coordinating the specialists who own each domain and the engineers who build the platform beneath it. The World Model is the governed knowledge layer beneath that view: a version-controlled library of definitions — the entities C360 recognises, their properties, relationships, and data lineage — maintained as structured content, published to an interactive web application, and consumed directly by C360's production AI assistants through a subscription model. In short, it is the shared vocabulary that keeps every team, dataset, and AI agent describing the client the same way. Job responsibilities Develops a product strategy and product vision that delivers value to customers Manages discovery efforts and market research to uncover customer solutions and integrate them into the product roadmap Owns, maintains, and develops a product backlog that enables development to support the overall strategic roadmap and value proposition Builds the framework and tracks the product's key success metrics such as cost, feature and functionality, risk posture, and reliability Own and maintain the enterprise data model, ensuring consistency, accuracy, and alignment across core client entities, including client identity, hierarchies, coverage roles, revenue metrics, and relationship measures. Resolve overlaps, conflicts, and gaps to deliver a unified product experience. Govern the change management process for the data model by managing a streamlined approval workflow, coordinating reviews, securing domain-owner sign-off, validating source references, and driving timely publication of approved updates. Establish and enforce data quality standards, reference integrity requirements, and content governance practices that support AI-enabled experiences. Partner with engineering teams to automate quality controls and embed validation checks into development and deployment pipelines. Manage and communicate the data consumption contract for AI assistants and downstream consumers, ensuring subscription accuracy, maintaining compatibility, and proactively coordinating breaking changes and release communications. Define and execute a focused roadmap for the data model product, prioritizing high-impact initiatives, balancing delivery against available capacity, and appropriately deferring or delegating lower-priority work. Collaborate across business and domain teams to align requirements, drive cross-functional decision-making, and escalate complex or disputed issues through established governance forums when necessary. Monitor and report on model health and operational performance through a consistent set of metrics, including data currency, reference integrity, backlog management, publication turnaround times, and subscription health. Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills 5+ years of experience or equivalent expertise in product management or a relevant domain area Advanced knowledge of the product development life cycle, design, and data analytics Proven ability to lead product life cycle activities including discovery, ideation, strategic development, requirements definition, and value management Product management or product ownership experience for a platform, data, or developer-facing product used by other teams — and comfort being its single, hands-on owner. A strong grasp of taxonomy, ontology, or data-model design: defining entities, relationships, and controlled vocabularies and keeping them consistent as they grow. Experience running a lightweight content or change workflow (intake → review → publish → retire) and getting things agreed through people you do not manage. A solid understanding of data lineage and provenance — the difference between a system of record and derived data, and why it matters for downstream trust. Comfort in a version-controlled, documentation-as-code environment (Git, structured Markdown / YAML, automated checks, pull-request review). Excellent prioritization and self-management — able to protect a focused roadmap and say no under real capacity limits. Clear, precise written communication — equally credible with engineers and with senior business stakeholders. Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills Demonstrated prior experience working in a highly matrixed, complex organization Experience in wholesale / CIB banking (Corporates, Financial Institutions, Commercial Real Estate, Public Sector) or the businesses C360 serves (Global Banking, Markets, Payments, Securities Services). Familiarity with client-data domains — client identity and hierarchies, coverage models, revenue and wallet share, and relationship analytics. An understanding of how AI / LLM agents consume a knowledge or semantic layer (retrieval-augmented generation, tool / MCP integration) and how content quality shapes agent behaviour. Exposure to knowledge-graph or ontology tooling (for example RDF / OWL, SKOS, taxonomy managers) or GraphQL. Experience working alongside a data-governance function or council.
